fullContentHtml:
UP Home Guard DV / PST Admit Card 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board (UPPRPB) will release the UP Home Guard DV / PST Admit Card 2026 on its official website. This recruitment was released for 41,424 posts. The applications for UP Home Guard Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 18 November 2025 to 17 December 2025. The PST examination will conducted on 13 July to 07 August 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their UP Home Guard DV / PST Admit Card 2026 Soon from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 18 November 2025
  • Application Start Date : 18 November 2025
  • Last Date : 17 December 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 17 December 2025
  • Correction Date : 18-21 December 2025
  • Exam Date : 25, 26 & 27 April 2026
  • Exam City Details : 18 April 2026
  • Admit Card : 22 April 2026
  • Answer Key : 07 May 2026
  • Final Answer Key : 28 June 2026
  • Result : 28 June 2026
  • DV / PST Exam : 13 July 2026
  • DV / PST Admit Card : 06 July 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 400/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 300/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Admit Card

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the admit card / hall ticket link.
  3. Enter your registration number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your admit card.
  5. Download and take a printout. Carry it to the exam center along with a photo ID.
